response.sql: WITH analysed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref) SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM analysed_trades GROUP BY tradekind;
